name: rensi-notebook
description: 仁思手札（Rensi Thinking Notebook）— 國中跨科互動課堂、即時 IRS 與 AI 評量規準系統

scripts.build: npm run lessons && npm run build:frontend
scripts.db:migrate:local: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply rensi-db --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply rensi-db --remote
scripts.dev: npm run build && npx wrangler dev --local
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler deploy
